content.text: The Four Pillars and the Role of Birth Time
Bazi is built on four pillars: Year, Month, Day, and Hour. Your birth time determines the Hour Pillar, which represents your inner world and long-term evolution.
The Hour Pillar Reveals Hidden Personality
While the Day Pillar shows your core identity, the Hour Pillar reveals deeper motivations, hidden talents, and how you behave when unobserved.
The Hour Pillar becomes more influential after midlife. It often shapes career direction shifts, creative expression, and long-term ambitions.
Even a two-hour difference can change the Hour Pillar entirely, altering hidden element interactions and long-term destiny interpretation.
